errors.text_span: 分别用蓝色、橙色和黄色表示
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors (blue, orange, yellow) to the models on the x-axis (Bert+MLP, GPlinker, 本文模型). The legend shows that the colors represent the metrics: blue for 准确率 (Precision), red/pink for 召回率 (Recall), and yellow for F1.
The vertical axis range is from 0 to 100, not 0 to 85.
The tick mark interval on the vertical axis is 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100), not 10.

errors.text_span: 每个柱状图对应一种模型
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart is a grouped bar chart where each model on the x-axis corresponds to a group of three bars, not a single bar.

errors.text_span: 它们的高度表示关系抽取结果的准确率
errors.evidence: The height of the bars does not represent only accuracy (准确率). The heights represent three different metrics as defined by the legend: 准确率 (Precision), 召回率 (Recall), and F1.

This sentence is completely incorrect. It assigns a single color to the 'Bert+MLP' category, which is a group of three bars. Furthermore, it lists a jumbled set of values from all three model groups, not just the values for Bert+MLP (which are 66.7, 72.7, and 69.5).

This sentence is completely incorrect. It assigns a single color to the 'GPlinker' category and lists a jumbled set of values from all three model groups, not just the values for GPlinker (which are 77.7, 77.7, and 77.7).

errors.text_span: 所有三种模型的柱状图均以相同的比例和高度排列
errors.evidence: This statement is nonsensical and factually incorrect. The bars for the models clearly have different heights. It seems to be trying to say that there is no special sorting, but the phrasing is confusing and wrong.
